# ============================================================
# 04 - 報酬 CSV を読んで源泉所得税を一括計算 → 結果 CSV
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 想定する CSV (先頭行ヘッダ): payee,amount
# 出力 CSV: payee,gross,tax,netPayment
# ============================================================
SET ExePath TO $'''C:\\work\\fincalc\\fincalc.exe'''
SET WorkDir TO $'''C:\\work\\fincalc'''
SET InPath TO $'''C:\\work\\fincalc\\samples\\fees.csv'''
SET WhOutPath TO $'''C:\\work\\fincalc\\out\\withholding.csv'''
SET ErrorLog TO $'''C:\\work\\fincalc\\out\\errors.log'''


# CSV (先頭行ヘッダ) をテーブルとして読み込む
File.ReadFromCSVFile.ReadCSV CSVFile: InPath Encoding: File.CSVEncoding.UTF8 TrimFields: True ColumnsSeparator: File.CSVColumnsSeparator.SystemDefault FirstLineContainsColumnNames: True CSVTable=> Fees

SET OutCsv TO $'''payee,gross,tax,netPayment'''
LOOP FOREACH Fee IN Fees
    # Fee[0]=payee, Fee[1]=amount
    # CLI を実行し stdout/stderr/exit code を CliOut/CliErr/CliExit へ格納
    Scripting.RunDOSCommand.RunDOSCommand DOSCommandOrApplication: $'''%ExePath% tax withholding --amount %Fee[1]%''' WorkingDirectory: WorkDir StandardOutput=> CliOut StandardError=> CliErr ExitCode=> CliExit

    IF CliExit <> 0 THEN
        # テキストを UTF8 でファイルへ追記 (ログ用)
        File.WriteText File: ErrorLog TextToWrite: $'''%Fee[0]%: %CliErr%''' AppendNewLine: True IfFileExists: File.IfFileExists.Append Encoding: File.FileEncoding.UTF8
    ELSE
        # stdout の JSON をカスタムオブジェクトへ変換
        Variables.ConvertJsonToCustomObject Json: CliOut CustomObject=> Wh
        SET OutCsv TO $'''%OutCsv%
%Fee[0]%,%Wh.grossAmount%,%Wh.tax%,%Wh.netPayment%'''
    END
END

# ファイルへテキスト書き込み (Mode: Overwrite / Append)
File.WriteText File: WhOutPath TextToWrite: OutCsv AppendNewLine: False IfFileExists: File.IfFileExists.Overwrite Encoding: File.FileEncoding.UTF8

# 情報ダイアログを表示 (Timeout 秒で自動的に閉じる)
Display.ShowMessageDialog.ShowMessageWithTimeout Title: $'''完了''' Message: $'''%WhOutPath% に出力しました''' Icon: Display.Icon.Information Buttons: Display.Buttons.OK DefaultButton: Display.DefaultButton.Button1 IsTopMost: False Timeout: 10
